Case Study: Design Portfolio Refresh

A clear, fun experience with personality

Consumer WebProduct DesignAI-Assisted Product DevelopmentMobile + Desktop

TL;DR

A portfolio that feels personal

A record-inspired portfolio built around meaningful connection: browse work through record sleeves, explore the case studies and optionally play music.

My role
Product design · AI-assisted product development
Timeline
October 2026

Problem

Expressive visuals need reliable interactions

The design direction asks for personality without losing clear navigation, readable text or consistent behavior across desktop and mobile. Repeated changes exposed problems with overlapping labels, inconsistent proportions and touch actions.

Process

Document the behavior as well as the look

The design system records the record-player geometry, LED housing, typography, color sequence and interaction rules. The landing page allocates space to text, the scene and controls; case studies use a shared reading layout.

Final product

A connected browsing experience

Shelf records open a browsable gallery. Expanded records transition into case studies on this website. Music remains optional, with direct play/pause controls and the selected song shown on the display.

Reflection

Preserve what works while refining the rest

The continuing design requirement is consistency: retain approved components, check responsive layouts and update the documented interaction patterns as decisions change. This case study documents the ongoing build; it does not claim measured hiring or engagement outcomes.
